records.title: 10-Q
records.text: In the three months ended March 31, 2021, we generated $156.9 million in total revenue.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The revenue mix for the three months ended March 31, 2021 was: cloud subscriptions 17%; software license 5%; maintenance 23%; services 51%; and hardware 4%.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Our international revenue was approximately $47.9 million for the three months ended March 31, 2021, which represents approximately 31% of our total revenue for the three months ended March 31, 2021, respectively.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: As previously announced, we have reversed the temporary actions that we had previously taken, effective on April 1, 2020, to manage operating expenses and cash flow due to the COVID-19 pandemic, and our Board of Directors has reinstated our share repurchase program.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the three months ended March 31, 2021, we generated cash flow from operating activities of $39.9 million.
